TASK ASSUMPTION CORRECTED: Burundi DOES have a statutory minimum wage, contrary to the assignment brief. Per Labour Code 2020 and Ministerial Order n.630/116 (1979), the legal daily minimum is BIF 160/day in urban areas (Bujumbura, Gitega) and BIF 105/day in rural areas, unchanged since 1 May 1988 (sources: WageIndicator Labour Rights Index country profile; Playroll/Global People Strategist payroll guides).

minimumWageEur=1.4 computed from urban statutory rate: BIF 160/day x 26 working days = BIF 4,160/month / 2900 BIF per EUR (DB exchangeRate) = EUR 1.43 -> 1.4. Rural rate would be EUR 0.94/month. Rate is nominal only - unenforced in the largely informal economy and eroded by inflation since 1988.
